channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rod Thorn | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rod Thorn from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jerry West on Rod Thorn
item.description:
ClutchPoints: Mavs head coach Jason Kidd shares a cool story about Jerry West:

“When I was with the Nets and Rod Thorn and we're going to Memphis to play [the Grizzlies] and I never seen a grown man drool before. I asked Rod why he was drooling and he was like, 'That's my idol.' And I was like looking for Michael Jordan... That's when I learned a little about West Virginia and it was an incredible moment.”

Jerry West on Rod Thorn, Jun 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Rod Thorn, Isiah Thomas
item.description:
McCallum said Jordan brought up the issue of Thomas himself in a 2011 interview.

“When they called me and asked me to play — Rod Thorn called me. I said ‘Rod, I won’t play if Isiah Thomas is on the team.’ He assured me. He said, ‘Chuck doesn’t want Isiah. So, Isiah is not going to be part of the team,’”

Michael Jordan on Rod Thorn, Isiah Thomas, May 26, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Rod Thorn
item.description:
“Before the Olympics, [selection committee chairman] Rod Thorn calls me and says we would love for you to be on the Dream Team,”

Michael Jordan on Rod Thorn, May 4, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Rod Thorn
item.description:
He returned to the game with a bandage on his nose, which wasn’t exactly a fashion statement for the 16-year veteran power forward.

“I don’t think it’s broke, but since it wasn’t a foul, I might get another flopping call from my boy [NBA President of Basketball Operations] Rod Thorn on Monday,”

Dirk Nowitzki on Rod Thorn, Dec 1, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Josh Harris on Rod Thorn
item.description:
The following is a statement from Sixers Managing Owner Josh Harris, on Rod Thorn departing to accept the President of Basketball Operations position with the NBA:

“Rod proved time and again to be a valuable and respected resource to me, our ownership group and the Philadelphia 76ers, and I would like to thank him for everything he provided to our organization,”

Josh Harris on Rod Thorn, Jul 10, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Rod Thorn
item.description:
But in a phone interview with FanHouse, Colangelo said no one has informed him he might be attempting to lure James to the Garden State.

“It's news to me (that he would be a candidate to replace Thorn),”

Jerry Colangelo on Rod Thorn, Jun 27, 2010. Source: FanHouse.com.
